booking.task: Build customer booking flow in booking.py and component tests

delivery.task: Implement delivery management in delivery.py and component tests

notifications.task: Implement customer notifications in notifications.py with component tests.

events.author: delivery
events.body: delivery.py public boundary: create_delivery(total_cents: int, customer: str, destination: str) -> dict; get_delivery(delivery_id: int) -> dict; cancel_delivery(delivery_id: int) -> dict; get_delivery_records() -> dict[int, dict], {} when empty. Records contain id (positive integer), total_cents (nonnegative integer), customer and destination (nonblank strings), status ('confirmed' or 'cancelled'), refund_cents (initially 0; cancellation saves total_cents). All returned records and ID-keyed snapshots are copies. Cancellation is idempotent. bool is rejected for integer inputs; invalid values raise ValueError, wrong types TypeError, unknown positive IDs KeyError. Strings are preserved after checking strip() is nonempty. IDs increase within the in-memory store. Full refunds implement TASK.md initial policy.

events.author: delivery
events.body: Published delivery-record interface event 1: create_delivery(total_cents, customer, destination) returns copied dict with id, total_cents, customer, destination, status, refund_cents. Positive integer IDs; nonnegative integer cents (no bool); nonblank customer/destination strings preserved. Initial confirmed/refund_cents=0; cancellation saves full refund and is idempotent. get_delivery_records() returns ID-keyed dict of copied records.

events.author: booking
events.body: booking_request(total_cents: int, customer: str, destination: str) -> dict validates nonnegative integer cents (bool rejected) and nonblank string customer/destination, raises ValueError for invalid values, and returns exactly total_cents/customer/destination preserving strings. page() -> str returns browser form posting JSON to /book, with server-returned id/status/total_cents/refund_cents displayed; cancellation via /cancel uses returned amounts only.

events.author: billing
events.body: Billing will consume the owner-published get_delivery_records() -> dict[int, dict] snapshot (event 1), iterating its values. summarize_records retains list[dict] support for existing callers and accepts the ID-keyed snapshot too. revenue_report returns {'revenue_cents': int, 'confirmed': int, 'cancelled': int}, with zero values for empty data; revenue sums saved total_cents - refund_cents regardless of status.

events.author: notifications
events.body: confirmation(email: str, delivery_id: int) -> str generates a local message only. Accept email with exactly one @, nonempty local/domain portions, a dotted domain with nonempty labels, and no whitespace; reject invalid values with ValueError. delivery_id must be a positive integer excluding bool; invalid values raise ValueError. Returns 'Delivery {delivery_id} is confirmed. Confirmation for {email}.' No money amounts, refund calculations, or outbound email. This formatter validates the supplied ID without fetching delivery state.

events.author: delivery
events.body: Implemented interface event 1 in delivery.py: validated create/get/cancel, monotonic positive IDs, copied snapshots/results, full saved refunds and idempotent cancellation. Added tests/test_delivery.py with six component tests covering lifecycle, zero amounts, isolation, invalid inputs/IDs, unknown IDs, and preserved strings. python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v passed all 7 available tests (six delivery plus baseline). Read booking interface event 3; its request kwargs match create_delivery. No other component implementation modified.

events.author: notifications
events.body: Implemented confirmation interface event 5 in notifications.py and added tests/test_notifications.py. Local message formatting validates email and positive integer delivery IDs (rejecting bool), includes recipient and delivery ID, and contains no monetary policy. Does not fetch records or send email. Validation: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v passed all 5 tests, including baseline. Only owned implementation and new component tests changed.

events.author: billing
events.body: Implemented billing.py against published delivery interface event 1. revenue_report calls get_delivery_records and summarizes dict values, with legacy flat-list compatibility. Counts statuses and sums actual saved total_cents minus refund_cents, including partial saved refunds, without mutation. Added tests/test_billing.py for empty shapes, both input shapes, saved refund accounting, fresh snapshots, and invalid records. All 5 locally available tests pass via python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v. Local delivery.py remains the starter stub, so create/cancel integration was not run here; snapshot boundary is tested with mocks. Only billing.py and new billing component tests changed.

events.author: booking
events.body: Implemented published booking interface event 3 in booking.py: validated request kwargs, accessible booking form posting /book, cancellation via /cancel, server status/total/refund rendering via textContent, and request errors/busy controls. Consumes delivery interface event 1. Added tests/test_booking_component.py covering validation, /book dispatch using mocked delivery, and Node-executed browser handlers including server partial refund 375/1250 and error rendering. python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v passed all 5 locally available tests. Local delivery remains starter stub; real delivery integration was not run. Only booking.py and new component test changed.

events.author: delivery
events.body: Apply a 400-cent cancellation fee: on first cancellation save refund_cents=max(total_cents-400, 0). Retained amount is min(total_cents,400). Repeated cancellation preserves saved refund. Billing continues using actual saved total minus refund. Human source: When a delivery is cancelled, keep a four-credit cancellation fee and refund the rest, never below zero.

events.author: delivery
events.body: Revision 2 supersedes full-refund behavior in event 1: cancel_delivery(delivery_id) now saves refund_cents=max(total_cents-400,0) on first cancellation and status='cancelled'; repeated cancellation preserves saved refund. All API signatures, record fields, validation, positive increasing IDs, and independent copied ID-keyed snapshots remain as in event 1. create_delivery starts status='confirmed', refund_cents=0. Fee is 4 credits = 400 cents; saved refund never negative.

events.author: delivery
events.body: Applied policy 10 in delivery.py: first cancellation saves max(total_cents-400,0), retaining min(total_cents,400); subsequent cancellation returns saved amounts unchanged. Updated delivery component tests for totals 0,1,399,400,401,1250 and snapshot isolation. All 7 locally available tests pass with python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v. Published boundary revision 2 in event 11. Only delivery.py and delivery component tests changed.
